description: Security fixes must not wait for the Thursday window, so this overrides the schedule only.

`minimumReleaseAge` is set here EXPLICITLY. Renovate force-applies `minimumReleaseAge: null` to this block, so omitting it drops the cooldown instead of inheriting it from packageRules. The cooldown guards against a compromised release that gets yanked within a day.

packageRules.description: Tooling and examples track new releases in the lockfile without rewriting their ranges
A published package's private dependency range starts at the version CI tested, so re-vendoring or publishing carries that floor into every app (PACKAGES.md -> Dependencies)

Apps own their peer versions. An in-range release only moves the devDependency copy that CI tests; an out-of-range release widens the peer so apps can upgrade on their own schedule (PACKAGES.md -> Dependencies)
Require explicit approval for npm majors so API and runtime compatibility get a human review before a branch is created
kysely-codegen peers on kysely; generated declarations and the query builder move together
@types/node must not expose APIs newer than the Node major in .nvmrc and CI
Node is governed by engines, .nvmrc and the CI setup-node version, and is bumped by hand
